glossary.label: Plain Language
glossary.heading: Jargon, translated
glossary.intro: The industry has a language problem. Here are the terms you'll actually hear, in words that mean something.

items.definition: A legal obligation to act in your best interest, not merely to recommend something suitable. It is a standard of care, not a marketing term.
The risk that poor market returns arrive early in retirement, while you are drawing income. The same average return can produce very different outcomes depending on when the bad years land.
The amount the IRS requires you to withdraw from certain retirement accounts each year once you reach the applicable age. Missing one carries a penalty.
Moving money from a pre-tax retirement account into a Roth account and paying the tax now, so that future growth and withdrawals can come out tax-free.
What you originally paid for an investment. It determines how much of a sale is taxable gain and how much is simply your own money coming back.
